briefTitle: Study of RAS(ON) Inhibitors in Patients With Advanced RAS-mutated NSCLC

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Received prior standard therapy appropriate for tumor type and stage
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy requirement is phrased generally as standard therapy appropriate for tumor type and stage without a specific drug or line count.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must have pathologically documented, locally advanced or metastatic RAS-mutated NSCLC (Subprotocol B)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General RAS-mutation does not map to a single specific typed KRAS, NRAS, or HRAS status check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must have pathologically documented, locally advanced or metastatic RAS G12D-mutated NSCLC (Subprotocol C and Subprotocol D)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: G12D mutation is specified for RAS broadly, and there is no typed kind for non-KRAS RAS variants like NRAS/HRAS G12D.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Primary central nervous system (CNS) tumors
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of primary CNS tumors is distinct from brain metastases criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Received prior standard therapy appropriate for tumor type and stage
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy requirement refers generally to standard therapy appropriate for tumor type and stage without naming a specific class or drug name.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must have pathologically documented, locally advanced or metastatic RAS-mutated NSCLC (Subprotocol B)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: RAS-mutated general category spans multiple variants and subprotocols, making it unsuitable for a single simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must have pathologically documented, locally advanced or metastatic RAS G12D-mutated NSCLC (Subprotocol C and Subprotocol D)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: RAS G12D mutation rule spans multiple subprotocols and is not mapped to a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Primary central nervous system (CNS) tumors
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of primary CNS tumors is not a standard brain metastases status check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Impaired gastrointestinal (GI) function that may significantly alter the absorption of RMC drugs
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: GI function impairment is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgery < 28 days of first dose
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window based on major surgery is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active or history of interstitial lung disease (ILD) or pneumonitis requiring steroids
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: ILD and pneumonitis history with steroid qualification is a clinical judgment condition.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: ECOG PS is 0 to 1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: deterministic normalizer did not verify this model check

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must have pathologically documented, locally advanced or metastatic KRAS G12C-mutated solid tumor malignancy (not amenable to curative surgery) (Subprotocol A)
